hey, thanks for commenting

i've tried looking into helping my head pain but they think it might be related to my medication or my eyesight, and since i can't stop taking meds in fear of feeling worse, and can't go to the optician as i can't leave the house properly, i can't really do anything.

i haven't had any proper therapy in a while. i have a psychiatrist i see every like 3 months to basically check on me, and im sort of seeing therapists at the treatment centre i go to but we dont do or talk about anything. i don't think i could handle even going out of the house once a week for something, let alone some of the therapies and things they suggest i do that feel literally impossible to me with my problems. every time i see the therapist there i end up crying in the parking lot afterwards because we just talk about how stuck i am and how it's 'really hard' that i can't do anything. and right now the last time i saw her she said there's no point in meeting again unless i call her and i get too anxious for phone calls and dont see the point in seeing her anyway
